verdict.rationale: Skills can be used without any interactive UI. They are passed in the Messages API `container` parameter (up to 20 per request) and run in the code execution environment. They can be uploaded and managed through the Skills API, and controlled programmatically in Claude Agent SDK sessions, which docs describe as using Claude Code as a library for production agents. missing for 10: explicit CI/pipeline integration docs or examples (e.g., a GitHub Actions recipe or a non-interactive CLI mode for skills), and independent hands-on reports of headless or CI use.
